# WanderAmsterdam

> Amsterdam tour discovery platform. 1630 bookable tours from local operators across Amsterdam and the wider Netherlands.

WanderAmsterdam helps travelers find and book Amsterdam experiences from local operators. We aggregate canal cruises, walking and bike tours, museum entries, food tours, and day trips out to Zaanse Schans, Volendam, Keukenhof, and the Dutch coast. Booking goes direct to the operator.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://wanderamsterdam.com/): Search and browse Amsterdam tours
- [All Tours](https://wanderamsterdam.com/tours.html): Complete tour directory with filters and a tour-finder quiz
- [Amsterdam City Guide](https://wanderamsterdam.com/amsterdam-city.html): Canal cruises, Jordaan and Red Light District walks, Rijksmuseum and Van Gogh combos
- [Travel Guides](https://wanderamsterdam.com/blog.html): Trip-planning notes and guides for Amsterdam
- [About](https://wanderamsterdam.com/about.html): How the directory works and how operators are listed
- [FAQ](https://wanderamsterdam.com/faq.html): Timing, accessibility, cancellation policies, what to bring

## Activity Guides

- [Fishing](https://wanderamsterdam.com/fishing.html): 15 fishing trips and charters out of Amsterdam; target species, charter ports, and season
- [Kayaking](https://wanderamsterdam.com/kayak.html): Guide to paddling routes near Amsterdam — canals, rivers, and lake runs worth a half-day
- [Jet Skis](https://wanderamsterdam.com/jet-ski.html): Guide to jet-ski rental hubs near Amsterdam, open-water routes, and the rules each spot enforces
- [Ziplines](https://wanderamsterdam.com/zipline.html): Guide to zipline parks reachable from Amsterdam — courses, height, and age ranges

## Quick Facts

- 1630 bookable tours from 70 local operators
- Amsterdam is the largest area covered, with tours also listed in Rotterdam, Den Haag, Delft, Utrecht, Dordrecht, Haarlem, Zaandam, Hoorn, Alkmaar, and the coastal towns of Zandvoort and Ouddorp
- Tours include: canal and boat tours, walking tours, city and history tours, museum entries, food tours, bike tours and bike rental, sightseeing and bus tours, private tours, boat rental, photography tours, pub crawls, sailing, and fishing
- Booking links go directly to tour operators via FareHarbor
- Prices are quoted in euros and vary by activity: about two-thirds of priced tours fall between roughly EUR 20 and EUR 190, with private charters and whole-boat hires running higher
